jokes.joke: Why did the scarecrow win an award?
jokes.punchline: Because he was outstanding in his field.

jokes.joke: Why did the bicycle fall over?
What do you call a bear with no teeth?
What do you call cheese that isn't yours?

poems.title: The Road Not Taken (Excerpt)
poems.author: Robert Frost
lines: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both

poems.title: Ozymandias
poems.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley
lines: I met a traveller from an antique land,
Who said: Two vast and trunkless legs of stone

poems.title: Daffodils
poems.author: William Wordsworth
lines: I wandered lonely as a cloud
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,

poems.title: Fire and Ice
poems.author: Robert Frost
lines: Some say the world will end in fire,
